summary: BUG-179 (Excel export empty) and BUG-180 (PDF export error) - BOTH VERIFIED FIXED. Tested Expense Report page export functionality with 30D date range (154 transactions, ₹64,104 total). Excel downloads .xls file with Summary + Transactions sheets. PDF opens new window with formatted HTML report showing KPIs + transaction table.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG-179 FIX VERIFIED: exportReportAsExcel() now receives correct payload shape with { title, restaurant, dateRange, kpis, sheets }
BUG-180 FIX VERIFIED: openReportWindow() called synchronously in click handler, then passed to exportReportAsPDF(win, payload)
buildExportPayload() function correctly constructs export data with 7 columns: Date, Item, Category, Amount, Payment, Added By, Notes
Excel file (21KB) contains 2 worksheets: Summary + Transactions with proper SpreadsheetML 2003 XML format
PDF opens in new window with proper title 'Expense Report — CAFE 103', KPI strip, and transaction table
seed_data_creation: Used existing 30D expense data (154 transactions, ₹64,104 total spend)
context_for_next_testing_agent: BUG-179/180 export fixes verified. Session expires quickly (~30s idle). Login takes ~20s. Use 30D preset for data. data-testid attributes: expense-report-download-trigger, expense-report-download-excel, expense-report-download-pdf, expense-report-preset-30d.

BUG_179_EXCEL_EXPORT.description: Click Download → 'Download as Excel' → .xls file downloads with transaction data
BUG_179_EXCEL_EXPORT.evidence: File 'Expense_Report_2026-06-12_2026-07-11.xls' (21KB) downloaded. Contains Summary sheet + Transactions sheet with 42 rows. Valid SpreadsheetML 2003 XML format.

BUG_180_PDF_EXPORT.description: Click Download → 'Download as PDF' → new browser window opens with formatted HTML report
BUG_180_PDF_EXPORT.evidence: New window opened with title 'Expense Report — CAFE 103'. Contains: EXPENSE REPORT header, CAFE 103 #644, date range, KPIs (Total Spend ₹64,104.00, Transactions 154, Active Days 14, Avg Daily ₹4,578.86, Top Category misc), Transactions table with 25 rows and 7 columns.

EXPENSE_REPORT_PAGE_LOAD.description: Expense Report page loads without errors - KPI strip, charts, transaction table render correctly
EXPENSE_REPORT_PAGE_LOAD.evidence: Page loaded with data-testid='expense-report-page'. KPI strip visible with 6 KPIs. Daily Expense Trend chart and Category Breakdown pie chart rendered. Transaction table shows 'Showing 25 of 154 · Page 1 of 7'.

DOWNLOAD_DROPDOWN_OPTIONS.description: Download button dropdown shows all 5 options (Excel, PDF enabled; Email, WhatsApp, SMS disabled)
DOWNLOAD_DROPDOWN_OPTIONS.evidence: All 5 options found: expense-report-download-excel (enabled), expense-report-download-pdf (enabled), expense-report-share-email (disabled), expense-report-share-whatsapp (disabled), expense-report-share-sms (disabled).
